goal.displayText: Independently request “Break, please” using speech or AAC during transitions.
goal.observableBehavior: Requests “Break, please” using speech or AAC
goal.independenceDefinition: The target response occurs without a teacher prompt after the natural cue and confirmed processing time.

successCriterion.maximumPromptLevel: Independent or the teacher-confirmed maximum prompt level

responseValidationRules: Speech and AAC are accepted equally
Accept any confirmed mode equally: speech, AAC

sequence: Independent opportunity, visual or gestural cue, model, then brief verbal prompt
promptingPlan.fadeRule: Fade to the least intrusive support after successful responding; teacher may pause or stop.
promptingPlan.teacherOverride: Teacher may pause or change prompting at any time

reinforcementPlan.specificPraise: You asked for a break by yourself.

transitionPlan.warning: Use First–Then, a one-minute visual warning, and present First–Then again on return
transitionPlan.breakRequest: Honor a two-minute break request with a visible timer
transitionPlan.returnSupport: Use First–Then, a one-minute visual warning, and present First–Then again on return

layoutRequirements: Use no more than four choices
prohibitedAudioFeatures: No audio prompts, sound effects, applause, or alarms

materialRequests.instructionalPurpose: Practice the goal in a motivating transition context
Provide speech and AAC-equivalent communication access
Represent progress toward the confirmed reward
Show the honored break duration without audio
Measure independent break requests and prompting
Document response modes and next steps

unresolvedAssumptions.text: Whether paired Spanish labels improve comprehension
Whether photographs or line drawings are preferred
